text:
nora: heads-up: customer reported that after the envelope-unwrapper shim landed, some streaming endpoints stop receiving X-Request-Meta on chunked requests. looks like metadata header is present on initial request but dropped mid-stream.

dan: repro steps?

nora: reproduce locally: curl -v -H 'Content-Type: application/envelope+json' -H 'X-Request-Meta: tenant=acme;trace=123' --data-binary @payload.json https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream/generate | grep X-Request-Meta -> header present initially, then not visible in backend logs for subsequent frames.

praveen: quick theory: the envelope shim was implemented in the ingress proxy to unwrap an outer envelope and rewrite body to application/llm-stream; we preserved headers on the initial proxy request but the downstream streaming proxy path starts a new HTTP/1.1 chunked tunnel and doesn't copy the per-request metadata to the tunneling frames.

kevin: are we sure this is our shim and not the customer's proxy? ask them for packet captures but we should defend on our edge too.

praveen: i reviewed the ingress diff 2 weeks ago. code uses: `proxyReq.Header = incoming.Header` before body swap. but later the streaming handoff path calls `startStream(req.Body, req.Trailer)` which creates a fresh `http.Request` and only copies a whitelist of headers. X-Request-Meta wasn't whitelisted.

nora: impact: audit customers that rely on header-based routing or telemetry (multi-tenant rules). we may silently misroute or fail compliance checks.

dan: immediate mitigation: add X-Request-Meta to the whitelist and add integration test. also add a compatibility mode: for tenants with `envelope_unwrap=legacy` keep old behavior (no unwrap), for `envelope_unwrap=preserve-meta` make sure header persist. default should be preserve-meta to avoid regressions.

kevin: agreed default preserve-meta. config surface: tenant flag + `X-Redwood-Compat: envelope-unwrap=preserve-meta|legacy` header opt-in. add env var `REDWOOD_ENVELOPE_UNWRAP=preserve-meta` for private installs.

praveen: implementation note: patch the streaming handoff to copy all `X-Redwood-` and `X-Request-` prefixed headers and any header listed in `req.Context().Value(extraHeaders)` to support future extensions. small change, trivial tests.

infra-bot: deploy queued: canary/envelope-meta-fix -> staging at 1716668905

ops: rollout plan: canary -> 2h -> 10% -> 24h audit. enable 0.1% telemetry event `envelope_unwrap.meta_missing=true` when header was absent on downstream frames. store tenant id and route.

kevin: docs: update migration guide section "Envelope wrapper" with note about header semantics, include curl example and `X-Redwood-Compat` header snippet. also add a short changelog entry and customer-facing KB.

nora: tests: unit for header copy, e2e with nginx ingress + our proxy to ensure no proxies rewrite header case/encoding, and an integration test simulating chunked frames. include encoded-header test: `X-Request-Meta: name=%41cme` -> preserves `name=Acme`.

praveen: one more thing  telemetry. sample tenants where we flip behavior and contact them before global change. add rollout checklist to PR.

kevin: i'll own comms + KB. nora, praveen please tag me on PR.

nora: i'll open the PR tonight with the whitelist change + tests.

ops: noted. tracking ticket INF-4721. will watch canary metrics. :eyes:
